technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum and trend confirmation offset by overbought conditions, weak moving average alignment, and negative volume signals; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CCI shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 48 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (30 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (87+ days old) with minimal conviction, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (401.76), flat yield curve with recession signals, imminent NFP event in 1 day, and 48-day earnings window create a highly adverse macro backdrop for CCI real estate exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX, three white soldiers, and supertrend bullish with extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) provide short-term momentum confirmation near support at 136.92.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 401.76, recession yield curve, imminent NFP), zero fundamental support, overbought oscillators, price below all key moving averages, negative volume (CMF/AO), and 48-day earnings window create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (ADX strong, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian signal) provide short-term entry confirmation at support. However, macro crisis regime, zero fundamental support, and overbought oscillators create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs momentum.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (401.76), recession-signal yield curve, imminent NFP event in 1 day, and 48-day earnings window create macro headwinds that will likely overwhelm technical strength and trigger sharp reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish, but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly bearish; macro environment dominates conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already hold CCI position and 6 other Real Estate positions in 283-open portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and warrant skip decision.
